endpoints.notes: mode is optional; mac accepts ':' '-' or bare hex; broadcast defaults to 255.255.255.255, port to 9; packet is sent 3 times; success means the packet was sent, not that the machine is up

Blocks link-local/metadata (169.254.0.0/16, fe80::/10, IPv4-mapped forms) and hostnames resolving to them; private LAN allowed. Redirects are not followed. useHealthToken:true without HEALTHCHECK_TOKEN → 400
Runs one poll tick now. started:false + reason already_running when a tick was in progress (nothing new ran).

notes: The Worker never calls /v1/* — the agent polls JANITOR_API_URL (/api/agent/poll → /api/agent/report). /v1/* is for local/LAN (or optional tunnel) manual use.

workerPoll.poll: GET $JANITOR_API_URL/api/agent/poll (Bearer AGENT_TOKEN, 30s timeout, backoff up to 5 min on failure)

reportFields.guestSyncServerIds: Proxmox links whose node list succeeded this round (guests pruned except failed nodes)
reportFields.guestSyncFailedNodes: { "<server_id>": ["node", ...] } — nodes whose guest list failed; their guests are kept
reportFields.pveNodes: [{ server_id, nodes: [{ node, online }] }] — only links whose node list succeeded
reportFields.speed: { down_mbps: number, up_mbps: number|null } — omitted when the probe failed
reportFields.jobs: [{ id: uuid, status: done|error, result?, error? }]
reportFields.services[].use_health_token: poll input: HEALTHCHECK_TOKEN is sent only when true
